# Redis Service

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `docker.redis.service` |
| Source | `09_docker/docker.redis.service.yaml` |
| Tags | docker, database |

Redis 7 instance configured with append-only persistence. Used for caching, queues,
and rate limiting across the content graph services.
